description_en: Restarts an E-MapReduce (EMR) Serverless StarRocks instance
description_zh: 本接口用于重启 Serverless StarRocks 实例
kebab_example: aliyun starrocks restart-instance --instance-id c-b25e21e243880000 --fast-mode true --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestartInstance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restart compute nodes in quick restart mode. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Compute nodes are restarted in quick restart mode in multiple batches. The batches are executed in parallel, and the nodes in each batch are restarted at the same time.
false: Compute nodes are restarted in rolling restart mode
parameters.help_zh:
是否以快速重启模式重启。默认为false。
true：以快速重启模式重启计算节点。分为多个批次重启计算节点，批次内并行重启，批次间串行执行；
false：以滚动重启模式重启计算节点
parameters.name: fast_mode
